title: The Flaw Chipmakers Spent 50 Years Fighting Is Now Their Best Feature: Memory Chip Fingerprinting
partialText: Every memory chip is designed to be exactly the same as all others, and none ever succeeds. They awaken with their own unique likes, leak at their own unique rate and react uniquely under stress. Decades of fighting such errors were abandoned when it was discovered that these faults do not duplicate between any two chips. Here is how one manufacturing flaw became an unclonable ID and how it can be used to identify you.
